The report describes campaigns against manufacturing companies in Italy and frames the trend as a warning for 2022.

0f7ff132baf7eda53163a89c4f74e547b72caa71.summary: Broadcom's protection bulletin describes Bofamet, a new Python-based infostealer found in the wild. From compromised endpoints it collects credentials, system information, browser cookies, Telegram session data, Discord tokens, screenshots and Steam configuration files. It exfiltrates this data to the attackers through a Telegram bot. The bulletin lists Symantec and Carbon Black detection names and recommends blocking malware execution.

0f7301a21c25468fd41c4eff0880dbf825b2664f.summary: Mandiant's May 2017 report attributes several 2017 incidents to FIN7, a financially motivated group active since 2015. FIN7 used application compatibility shim databases for persistence, patching services.exe to launch the CARBANAK backdoor, and also installed a payment card harvesting utility this way. The report describes the mechanism, names the sdbinst.exe tool, and gives detection recommendations.

0fd73fb19634637c9d66265f9b891826d8fffbea.summary: Objective-See blog writeup dated July 2, 2019, describing macOS local privilege escalation research. It covers dylib hijacking in third-party apps, and App Store installer weaknesses that let a researcher write files into root-owned app folders via symlinks. A benign 'Crontab Creator' app was used to place a root cron file, and a second LaunchDaemons variant is described. The report says Apple fixed the installer path in Mojave (October 2018 fix, then a 10.14.5 fix), without assigning a CVE. The author says the story continues with a bypass of Apple's fix.

0f93147df483ea3eb02b0fa7268f8d23c6d0b051.summary: 360 Netlab reports that the z0Miner mining botnet spreads by exploiting remote command execution flaws in ElasticSearch (CVE-2015-1427) and the Jenkins script console. Infected hosts kill competing miners, set up cron jobs that fetch scripts from Pastebin, and download an XMR miner. The report says over 22 XMR have been mined so far.
